Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add total available orbits and world assignment calculations \(v0.12.0\)

This update implements calculations for distributing worlds to stars based on
available orbital space:

Features:
- Calculate Total Available Orbits for each star \(Max - Min - Unavailable + bonus\)
- Calculate System Total Available Orbits \(sum of all stars\)
- Calculate System Total Worlds \(Gas Giants + Planetoid Belts + Terrestrial Planets\)
- Assign worlds to each star proportionally based on available orbits
- Primary stars get rounded up allocation
- Outermost companion gets remaining worlds
- Comprehensive debug logging of all calculations

Changes:
- Star.cs: Added TotalAvailableOrbits and WorldsAssigned properties
- StarSystem.cs: Added calculation methods and orchestration
- StarSystem.cs: Updated console output to display new values
- Version.cs: Updated to v0.12.0

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
